neighbours.label: ' and' joining two prepositions of place or relation (between and around, within and along, in and out of); ' and' joining nouns, and single prepositions in the same frames stay quiet
fire: Fish swim between and beneath the coral branches.
Trade grew within and across national borders.
Mud collects under and around the old pipes.
She moved through and past the waiting crowd.
Cooperation among and between the tribes improved.
Plants grow on and along the stone wall.
Roots spread above and below the waterline.
Tension rose inside and outside the union.
